jade (Acme): Hey, seeing weird partial SSE payloads from the /events endpoint after we rotated our API key. Client receives half an event then reconnects and gets the rest as a new event. Repro is consistent when traffic goes through our gRPC->gRPC-web gateway.

laura (Support): sorry about that — can you paste a minimal repro (curl or client) and a short copy of the raw bytes you see? also are you on Redwood hosted or Dedicated?

jade (Acme): Hosted. Repro (simplified):
```bash
# client connects using EventSource polyfill (gRPC-web path)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ROTATED_KEY}" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  "https://api.redwood.com/v1/events?stream=true"\n```
Raw chunk snapshot (from client side):
```
data: {"id":"123","text":"part-1..."}
data: {"id":"123","text":"part-2\n```
(second chunk truncated, then client reconnects, server sends remainder as new id 123-1)

laura (Support): thanks. does server log show a 200 for the first connection? any 401/403 during rotation?

jade (Acme): server logs show 200 then keep-alive then FIN from proxy. No 401. Timing aligns with our key rotation window (short overlap). We only see reassembly when the path hits an env-proxy cluster (gRPC-web transform). Direct to redwood-hosted endpoint (h2 straight) is fine.

ryan (Eng): :thinking_face: this smells like intermediary buffering/mangling of chunked transfers when translating between HTTP/2 frames and HTTP/1.1 chunk encoding for gRPC-web. gRPC-web gateway sometimes coalesces frames or enforces max-chunk sizes, which can split SSE event boundaries.

miguel (SRE): adding: sometimes proxies will close idle streams or swap connections after auth refresh. If the proxy closes mid-frame, the client sees a truncated chunk and tries to reconnect — server treats the resumed conversation as a new event. Also check for header mutations (transfer-encoding, content-type) and missing `Connection: keep-alive` semantics on h1 hops.

laura (Support): can you capture a pcap or use `curl --raw` to show exact bytes over the wire? if we can see the intermediate gateway responses we can confirm if it's inserting/re-chunking.

jade (Acme): attached a hex dump. Also noticed the gateway injects an intermediate `grpc-status` trailer on reconnects which our client doesn't expect for SSE. Sample gateway snippet: `HTTP/1.1 200 OK\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\nContent-Type: text/event-stream\n...\n0\ngrpc-status: 12\n\n`

ryan (Eng): that trailer is the culprit — gRPC-web adapters sometimes append trailers even for streaming HTTP/1 endpoints. If the proxy sends a `0\r\n` chunk (end) with a trailer, some SSE clients treat it as stream termination and then reconnect; combined with auth handover it becomes a partial event. Two mitigations: 1) configure the gateway not to add grpc trailers for SSE paths, or 2) ensure the proxy preserves original chunk boundaries (no rebuffering), or 3) on our side, add idempotent event assembly (server tags event continuation).

laura (Support): I'll escalate to infra and mark this P2 (affecting a single customer but reproducible). For immediate workaround: can you route the path to the h2 passthrough (bypass gRPC-web) and confirm behavior?

jade (Acme): routing through h2 passthrough fixed it. Can we get a config change on the gateway? Also worried about billing — client reconnects double-count tokens/requests in our usage. Any advice?

miguel (SRE): for billing, we can audit the requests and issue a credit for duplicate/failed partial streams if you provide the time ranges and request ids. For longer term, we're going to: (a) add a proxy rule to disable gRPC trailers on /v1/events, (b) update docs about SSE over gRPC-web caveats, and (c) add a server-side header `X-Redwood-Stream-Continuation: true` to help clients reassemble.

ryan (Eng): also filing an internal ticket to add a compatibility test: SSE through gRPC-web gateway vs h2 passthrough with key rotation scenarios.

laura (Support): action items: 1) jade to confirm h2 passthrough is ok for now, 2) laura will request proxy disable trailers for that route, 3) jagged-billing audit request (attach times). tagging @miguel for the credit path. :white_check_mark:

jade (Acme): confirmed passthrough good. Thanks — please loop me when proxy change is deployed.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to gateway-config at 2026-03-17T16:45Z (rolling) — change: disable grpc trailers on /v1/events for tenant acme

laura (Support): closing the immediate loop; reopening if you see any further partial events after deploy. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
